verdict.rationale: PayPal ships extensive official SDKs and REST/GraphQL APIs (paypal-docs-1, paypal-docs-54, paypal-supp-braintree-graphql), a dedicated AI agent toolkit supporting LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, Bedrock, and MCP (paypal-gh-1, paypal-gh-2, paypal-supp-toolkit-frameworks), plus a live OAuth-gated remote MCP server verified by probe (paypal-probe-4) and sandbox testing support (paypal-docs-11). This is strong, verifiable, first-party AI-native SDK support with independent probe corroboration. missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews/hands-on reports of building with the SDKs beyond PayPal's own docs and probes, and broader language coverage details beyond TypeScript/Python.
